messages:
kevin-pm: Quick heads up — Alpha Health (enterprise) asked about a VPC/on‑prem private deployment. They want data to never leave their network, HSM for keys, and a 3‑month target for GA. Can we triage feasibility and list blockers?

jess-support: Filed contact + initial requirements from the customer. They require SOC2, FedRAMP scoped controls, and nightly audit logs to their SIEM. Customer rep is @emily.alpha.

sandeep-eng: Initial blockers I see: private registry + airgapped images, model weight transfer (large), CUDA/GPU driver compatibility, KMS/HSM integration, networking (NAT egress restrictions), and installer for offline infra.

sandeep-eng: Quick checklist draft:
```
- Image transfer path (s3 out -> USB/ops transfer)
- Installer that works without external endpoints
- GPU drivers supported (NVIDIA driver + CUDA), target driver versions: 510+
- KMS/HSM flow (PKCS#11 or Cloud HSM)
- Private metrics sink (push or scrapers to customer prometheus)
- Audit/event export to customer's SIEM
- License / entitlements for model weights
```

anna-sec: Security notes: need key-holding policy, HSM attestation, formal threat model, and supply-chain verification for model weights. Also need an approval gate for export controls if models have restricted weights.

mike-sre: Capacity notes: if they require low latency inference on-prem we need sizing for GPU pool. Options: quantized model to reduce memory, or schedule a dedicated pool (reserved capacity). ETA for a sizing spike: 3 days once we have sample load/profile.

kevin-pm: Customer target is 3 months, but we need to split into phases: 1) 2‑week feasibility spike, 2) MVP on‑prem installer + basic KMS + monitoring, 3) hardened GA with SOC2 evidence. Who owns the spike?

sandeep-eng: I can take the spike with help from mike-sre (sizing) and anna-sec (threat model). Spike deliverables: feasibility doc, blocker list, prototype install script, and dev notes for handoff. Estimate 10 dev days.

jess-support: Customer says they can provide an on‑site engineer and dedicated network window for image transfer. They expect a weekly sync.

infra-bot: Created ticket INF-4821: "alpha-health on-prem feasibility spike" — assignees: sandeep-eng, mike-sre.

kevin-pm: OK — plan for spike this sprint. Acceptance criteria for spike: documented install path without internet, validated KMS integration (even if mocked), and rough cost/sizing. After spike we'll decide backlog priority.

anna-sec: Add to acceptance: verification of audit log export and key rotation procedure.

kevin-pm: Thanks — I'll add this to product intake and set weekly syncs. @sandeep-eng please post the feasibility doc in #product when ready.

sandeep-eng: Will do. Starting Monday — will post progress updates here. :thumbsup:
